title: Multilevel pulse-area control in Physical Review A
summary: A multilevel pulse-area framework uses infrared and delayed terahertz pulses to control molecular vibration and rotation. The study appears in Physical Review A.

title: Robust enantioselective state transfer in ChemPhysChem
summary: A coherent microwave control scheme uses composite pulses to make enantioselective state transfer more robust against pulse-area errors. The study appears in ChemPhysChem.
